description: Get exchange rate for any token via Aave V4's Chainlink oracle integration. Supports ERC-20 tokens, native tokens (ETH), and fiat currencies. Pass EITHER tokenAddress OR native:true. No API key needed.

native.description: Set true to get native token (ETH) price instead of ERC-20

to.description: Target currency: USD, EUR, or GBP

tokenAddress.description: ERC-20 token address (e.g. WETH: 0xC02aaA39b223FE8D0A0e5C4F27eAD9083C756Cc2). Required unless native:true.

name: get_v4_exchange_rate
